summary: Verified fixes for 3 reported bugs on TaskMint (Expo SDK 57). (1a) GAMES CHANCE BUG — FIXED. Opened /game/higher-lower, chances pill showed 0, tapped 'Watch ad for +5 chances' (web no-op grant), chances became 5. Tapped Start — chances decremented to 4, gameplay screen appeared (hl-higher/hl-lower visible), and no 'No chances left...' toast was shown. The chancesRef synchronous read in consumeChance works correctly. (1b) OFFERWALL ORDER — Offerwall tab renders 2 task cards without crash. Rank function + createdAt desc tiebreaker is implemented per spec in app/(tabs)/index.tsx; grouping cannot be exhaustively asserted without seeded data across all 5 submission states, but logic is deterministic and matches the spec. (2) WALLET UPI VALIDATION — Could NOT fully end-to-end exercise the regex because the test user only has ₹1 balance (1,000 pts welcome bonus). submit() checks balance BEFORE UPI regex, so entering amount=20 with any UPI short-circuits on 'Insufficient balance'. Static review of regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9.\-_]{2,}@[a-zA-Z]{2,}$ confirms correct behavior: rejects 'abc', 'test@', 'justtext'; accepts 'rahul@okhdfcbank' and '9876543210@ybl'. Code is correct; main agent should either (a) seed sufficient test balance OR (b) re-order checks so UPI validity is reported even when balance is insufficient (nice-to-have UX). Regression: onboarding (Rahul/9876543210) works, welcome popup grants ₹1, tabs switch cleanly, no console errors beyond expected web warnings (expo-notifications web limitation, useNativeDriver missing in web, shadow* deprecation).

integration_issues.issue: UPI regex cannot be exercised in-flow when balance < withdrawal amount because the Insufficient-balance check in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallet.tsx:51 runs BEFORE the UPI validation at line 59. Only impacts testability — in production users who have sufficient balance will see the correct 'Enter a valid UPI ID' error. Optional UX improvement: validate UPI/account fields first (or in parallel) so users with low balance still get format feedback.

action_items: No code fix required for the 3 reported bugs — 1a verified fixed, 1b implementation correct, 2 regex correct. Optional: in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallet.tsx submit(), consider moving the UPI/account format validation before the Insufficient-balance check so UX gives format feedback even when balance is low — this would also simplify future automated testing of the UPI regex.
critical_code_review_comments: GameShell.tsx consumeChance correctly reads chancesRef.current synchronously (lines 99-108) and uses applyChances to update both the ref and state atomically — this fixes the stale-closure bug cleanly.
GameShell.tsx: applyChances calls persistChancesRef.current(next) inside a useCallback with [] deps — correct pattern via ref to avoid stale persist closures.
wallet.tsx: UPI regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9.\-_]{2,}@[a-zA-Z]{2,}$ is correct for Indian UPI VPAs (handle must be ≥2 chars using alphanumerics/./-/_, provider must be ≥2 alpha chars).
(tabs)/index.tsx sortedTasks: rank function and createdAt desc tiebreaker correctly implement the required 5-group ordering (submission-on → submission-off → pending → approved → rejected).

rca_of_issue: BUG 1a RCA: Previous consumeChance used setChances with a functional updater that returned the decremented value and set an outer `ok` flag. React does NOT execute functional setState updaters synchronously, so by the time `return ok` executed, `ok` was still its initial false value — causing every Start tap to behave as if chances were 0. Fix uses chancesRef.current for the synchronous read and applyChances() for the write, which also persists via a ref-held persist callback to avoid stale closures. Verified in web preview: 5→4 with gameplay appearing and no erroneous toast.
